rationale: Locked task list visible to reports + reviewers. Non-canonical data stays on disk but is invisible to renderer + report. Eliminates the case-by-case interpretation problem; report = filtered against this file.
scope: Task-1 04 Vanilla CPT diagnostic; expected to be inherited by Task-2 with at most a documented extension.

retention.subdomain_aggregation_rule: global_mmlu_<lang> = mean(business, humanities, medical, other, social_sciences, stem); the upstream lm-eval bundle already emits the aggregate row, so the renderer reads the aggregate key directly and does not need to re-mean subdomains.
retention.absent_on_disk_note: xstorycloze_<lang> is in the cpt-plan.md §2.1 'tasks per language' default proposal but is NOT present in the upstream lm-eval 'retention_only' bundle as executed for this run; we mark these explicitly so coverage gaps are visible rather than silently dropped.
